nodes.name: Trigger — Mission Webhook
nodes.notes: Entry point. n8n fires this when a mission is created or updated with vegetation_analysis=true. Payload: { mission_id: string }.

nodes.name: E0 — Check Mission
nodes.notes: Fetch mission record. Verify vegetation_analysis=true and mission exists.

parameters.content: Mission does not have vegetation_analysis=true. Workflow stops here.

nodes.name: E0 — Poll Ortho Path
nodes.notes: Fetch output_path from drone_jobs. The ortho is expected at {output_path}\mapping\orthomosaic.tif (Path C output).

nodes.name: E0 — Wait 60s
nodes.notes: Poll every 60 seconds for Path C ortho to appear. Max 30 attempts = 30 minutes timeout.

nodes.name: E0 — Check Ortho Exists
nodes.notes: Windows batch command to check if ortho file exists on disk.

nodes.name: E0 — Set Failed (Timeout)
nodes.notes: Path C ortho never appeared after 30 minutes. Mark vegetation_status=failed and halt.

nodes.name: Set Status — Detecting
nodes.notes: Ortho confirmed. Patch vegetation_status='detecting' and insert 4 processing_steps rows.

nodes.name: Insert Processing Steps
nodes.notes: Insert 4 processing_steps rows (all status=waiting) for E1-E4.

parameters.command: =C:\Users\redle.SOULAAN\Documents\drone-pipeline\.venv-path-e\Scripts\python.exe C:\Users\redle.SOULAAN\Documents\drone-pipeline\canopy_detection.py --mission-id {{ $('Trigger — Mission Webhook').item.json.body.mission_id }} --ortho-path "{{ $('E0 — Build Ortho Path').item.json.ortho_path }}" --processing-job-id {{ $('E0 — Check Mission').item.json[0].processing_job_id }}

nodes.name: E1 — Canopy Detection
nodes.notes: Runs canopy_detection.py. Expects JSON stdout with {canopy_count, geopackage_path, geojson_path, processing_steps}. Exit 0=success, 1=fatal error, 2=partial.

nodes.name: E1 — Zero Canopies?
nodes.notes: If canopy_count=0, skip E2/E3 and go directly to E4 with 'no vegetation detected' note.

nodes.name: Set Status — Classifying
nodes.notes: E1 completed with canopies detected. Advance status to classifying before E2.

parameters.command: =C:\Users\redle.SOULAAN\Documents\drone-pipeline\.venv-path-e\Scripts\python.exe C:\Users\redle.SOULAAN\Documents\drone-pipeline\species_classification.py --mission-id {{ $('E1 — Parse Result').item.json.mission_id }} --ortho-path "{{ $('E1 — Parse Result').item.json.ortho_path }}" --processing-job-id {{ $('E1 — Parse Result').item.json.processing_job_id }} --max-canopies 200

nodes.name: E2 — Species Classification
nodes.notes: Runs species_classification.py. --max-canopies from vegetation_config default (200). Exit 0=success, 1=fatal, 2=partial.

nodes.name: Set Status — Assessing
nodes.notes: E2 completed. Advance status to assessing before E3.

parameters.command: =C:\Users\redle.SOULAAN\Documents\drone-pipeline\.venv-path-e\Scripts\python.exe C:\Users\redle.SOULAAN\Documents\drone-pipeline\health_assessment.py --mission-id {{ $('E2 — Parse Result').item.json.mission_id }} --ortho-path "{{ $('E2 — Parse Result').item.json.ortho_path }}" --processing-job-id {{ $('E2 — Parse Result').item.json.processing_job_id }} --vision-sample-pct 0.3

nodes.name: E3 — Health Assessment
nodes.notes: Runs health_assessment.py. --vision-sample-pct from vegetation_config default (0.3). Exit 0=success, 1=fatal, 2=partial.

nodes.name: Set Status — Generating Report
nodes.notes: E3 completed (or zero-canopy bypass). Advance status to generating_report before E4.

parameters.command: =C:\Users\redle.SOULAAN\Documents\drone-pipeline\.venv-path-e\Scripts\python.exe C:\Users\redle.SOULAAN\Documents\drone-pipeline\vegetation_report.py --mission-id {{ $('E3 — Parse Result').item.json.mission_id || $('E1 — Parse Result').item.json.mission_id }} --ortho-path "{{ $('E3 — Parse Result').item.json.ortho_path || $('E1 — Parse Result').item.json.ortho_path }}" --tier standard --output-dir "E:\output\{{ $('E3 — Parse Result').item.json.mission_id || $('E1 — Parse Result').item.json.mission_id }}\vegetation" --processing-job-id {{ $('E3 — Parse Result').item.json.processing_job_id || $('E1 — Parse Result').item.json.processing_job_id }}

nodes.name: E4 — Report Generation
nodes.notes: Runs vegetation_report.py. --tier from mission config (standard/extended/comprehensive). Receives both zero-canopy path (from E1) and normal path (from E3). Exit 0=success, 1=fatal, 2=partial.

nodes.name: Set Status — Review
nodes.notes: E4 complete. Patch vegetation_status='review' before entering operator review gate.

nodes.name: Review Gate — Webhook Wait
Process Decisions
nodes.notes: Parse operator review decisions. Separate excluded/flagged/approved detection IDs.

nodes.name: Any Exclusions?
nodes.notes: If operator excluded any detections, re-run E4 to regenerate report without those canopies.

nodes.name: Apply Exclusions
nodes.notes: Mark excluded detections in vegetation_detections table before re-running E4.

nodes.name: Apply Flags
nodes.notes: Mark flagged detections in vegetation_detections table.

nodes.name: E4 — Regenerate Report
nodes.notes: Re-run E4 with exclusions applied in DB. vegetation_report.py will filter excluded=true rows when building report.

nodes.name: Set Status — Complete
nodes.notes: Final step. Patch vegetation_status='complete'. Delivery packaging can now include vegetation subfolder.

nodes.name: Respond to Review Webhook
nodes.notes: Send 200 response back to the POST /sentinel-vegetation-resume caller.

nodes.name: Error Handler — Set Failed
nodes.notes: Global error handler. Any E script exit code 1 routes here. Sets vegetation_status=failed.

_meta.description: Path E Vegetation Analysis workflow for Sentinel Aerial Inspections. Triggers on mission.vegetation_analysis=true, waits for Path C ortho, runs E1→E2→E3→E4 sequence, pauses at operator review gate, applies decisions, and marks mission complete.
_meta.node_sequence: E0 (Check Ortho) → E1 (Canopy Detection) → E2 (Species Classification) → E3 (Health Assessment) → E4 (Report Generation) → Review Gate → Process Decisions → Complete
